FIT_TOOLTIP: Along the whole edge, or only as long as its buttons, in the middle.
MICROMENU_TOOLTIP: Character, spellbook, talents, achievements, quest log and the other game menu buttons.
EXPERIENCE_TOOLTIP: Experience with rested experience; at the level cap, the reputation you show as an experience bar.
CURRENCIES_TOOLTIP: Gold and the currencies you show on the backpack (Currency tab).
BAGS_TOOLTIP: Backpack, bag slots and reagent bag, with free slots.
FADED_ALPHA_TOOLTIP: How visible the panel stays while hidden. Even when visible, a hidden panel can't be clicked.
CONDITION_TOOLTIP: A macro condition that decides alone, for example [combat] hide; show. Empty: the settings above decide.
TIP_LEVEL: Full in %d min (%d more gains like the last)
